prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture in soft matte white, subtle fibers, delicate pearlescent accents and elegant folds with precise geometry. The design is inspired by a wedding invitation aesthetic, with a refined pink ribbon, warm wooden details and a tactile wax seal; **the seal of the envelope must explicitly feature two intertwined wedding rings engraved**. The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a romantic, narrative scene of blooming sakura flowers and soft cherry blossom branches, softly blurred but visually recognizable, with delicate petals drifting through the air and warm wooden elements subtly framing the composition. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including sakura petals, blossoms, floating dust, gentle sparkles and soft light particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating gently, enhancing motion and elegance without overpowering the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric light rays streaming from above or behind. Gentle atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, romantic and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, dominated by white, blush pink and warm wood tones, with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic fantasy realism, elegant, romantic, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium wedding invitations and storytelling visuals.
instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a pristine blank sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying nearly the entire frame while still allowing visible space around it for the floor, background and side elements. The sheet feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, clean edges and elegant natural curvature. The blank surface remains completely empty and luminous, designed as a central canvas, while delicate ornamental details frame it without covering the writing area. Surrounding the sheet are tasteful floral adornments and decorative accents in a romantic palette of white, pink and warm wood tones: soft roses, small blossoms, petals, thin branches, dried floral touches, wooden decorative pieces, and subtle organic arrangements placed around the edges and sides. These elements feel natural, airy and elegant, enhancing the composition without overpowering the blank page.

The environment is rich and story-driven, not a flat backdrop. The background suggests a refined floral setting with soft depth: a light wooden surface, gentle natural textures, blurred botanical decor, and a serene elegant atmosphere. The floor remains partially visible beneath the sheet, adding realism and spatial grounding. Side elements create framing and depth, while the blank sheet stays clearly the hero of the scene. Lighting is cinematic, soft and luminous, with a delicate key light illuminating the paper, subtle rim light defining its edges, and gentle ambient light reflecting the pink, white and wood color palette. Light rays are soft and natural, with a dreamy premium feel. Shadows are realistic, soft and directional, enhancing the paper’s volume and the surrounding floral details.

Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, occupying almost the full frame, with visible floor, background and side elements for context; strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornamental details, soft bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic floral elegance, clean, refined, premium stationery aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, soft volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for elegant floral stationery and premium design visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Floral) e na paleta de cores (Branco, rosa e madeira). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Casamento Lívia & André". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
